verdict.rationale: Reader's own GitHub docs describe an `x-markdown-chunking` header that turns on semantic chunking of the markdown response. It returns a JSON array of chunks instead of one blob, which matches the story's request for retrieval-ready chunked output. The documentation is a single line, so how chunks are formed and controlled is not shown. Missing for 10: details on chunking parameters (chunk size, overlap, boundary strategy) and chunk metadata, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality in a RAG pipeline.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline

citations.quote: `x-markdown-chunking` — opt-in semantic chunking of the markdown response. Returns a JSON array (or ``-delimited text) of chunks instead of one blob
Get improved output for your agent and RAG systems at no cost.
